  • Ruffled feathers, drooped tail
  • Pale comb, no morning egg song
  • Limping or curled toes
Keeping hens happy
  • Lice and mites love a dirty coop — diatomaceous earth around the roost helps.
  • Hard-boiled eggshells are fine calcium back, but a feed supplement is safer.
  • Never feed avocado, onions, or chocolate.
  • Nesting box: one per four hens, lined with pine shavings.
